title: 024 - Countdown Sequence
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print the countdown as 3-2-1 and prints exactly `3-2-1`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function countdownSequence(int $year, int $month, int $day): string
{
    return strval($year) . "-" . strval($month) . "-" . str_pad(strval($day), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT);
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function countdownSequence(int $year, int $month, int $day): string
{
    return strval($year) . "-" . str_pad(strval($month), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT) . "-" . str_pad(strval($day), 2, "0", STR_PAD_LEFT);
}
hint: The loop stops too early or includes one extra step.
explanation: The loop boundaries are wrong. Iterating from 3 down to 1 fixes the countdown.
